headline: Indian Digital Payment Stocks Decline as Regulatory UPI Fee Rollout Faces Delays
summary: Shares of Paytm parent One 97 Communications dropped 6.3%, while Pine Labs fell 3.7% and One Mobikwik lost 7.3%, after news surfaced that the implementation of UPI transaction fees faces delays.
why: Paytm and peer fintech firms operate digital payment networks dependent on fee structures approved by financial regulators.

impacts.name: One 97 Communications
impacts.why: Delays in implementing UPI payment processing fees pushed Paytm shares 6.3% lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty regarding transaction monetization timelines hurt valuation multiples across listed Indian payment providers.
